_help: Edit weights, patterns and actions here. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions. Priority score = urgency + severity + amount points + (fraud score x fraud_priority_weight), capped at 100.

Medium: Assign for standard review within the normal SLA
High: Fast-track to an experienced claims officer today
Critical: Assign immediately to a senior claims officer

urgency_signals.label: Serious injury or hospitalisation
actions: Confirm medical status and treatment costs
Check whether a guarantee of payment is needed

urgency_signals.label: Fatality
actions: Assign to a senior officer with bereavement-handling training

urgency_signals.label: Injury reported
actions: Obtain a medical report or certificate

urgency_signals.label: Policyholder displaced from home
actions: Offer the temporary accommodation benefit if covered
Arrange a loss adjuster visit within 48 hours

urgency_signals.label: Fire or explosion
actions: Request the fire department report
Arrange a loss adjuster site inspection

urgency_signals.label: Flooding or water damage
actions: Request a plumber or contractor report
Advise the policyholder on mitigating further damage

urgency_signals.label: Loss of essential services
actions: Prioritise emergency repair authorisation

urgency_signals.label: Total loss or destruction
actions: Obtain a valuation for the insured item

urgency_signals.label: Regulatory or deadline pressure
actions: Check the regulatory response deadline and diarise it

severity_signals.label: Litigation or legal threat
actions: Notify the legal team and diarise the response deadline
Appoint a panel lawyer if proceedings are likely

severity_signals.label: Third party involved
actions: Obtain the third party's contact and insurer details

fraud_indicators.label: Recent increase in coverage
actions: Verify the policy change dates and the reason for the increase

fraud_indicators.label: Loss soon after policy inception
actions: Verify the policy inception date against the date of loss
Check the application for non-disclosure

fraud_indicators.label: No official report available
actions: Request the police or fire department report

fraud_indicators.label: Cash-only or weak documentation
actions: Request supplier invoices and bank payment records

fraud_indicators.label: Pressure for fast settlement
actions: Do not commit to a settlement timeline until verification is complete

fraud_indicators.label: Refuses or avoids inspection
actions: Require an inspection before payment and preserve the site
Suspend payment pending inspection

fraud_indicators.label: Pattern of prior claims
actions: Run a claims history check across insurers

fraud_indicators.label: Inconsistent dates or documents
actions: Verify the documents directly with the issuer

fraud_indicators.label: Possible pre-existing condition
actions: Review the application for non-disclosure of the condition

insufficient_detail.label: Insufficient detail in claim summary
actions: Request incident date, cause and supporting photos or documents
Confirm the policy and cover that apply
Hold triage until the missing details are received
